prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1081; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred when the other vehicle struck our client while she was making a left turn. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We ask that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the identity of the adjuster assigned to this claim.

We further request that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, witness statements, claim notes, repair and total-loss records, and all communications with the insured or any third party. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any later proceeding.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
